text: In connection with the Easter holiday, travel by metro and bus in Tbilisi will be free.

In connection with the Easter holiday, the Tbilisi Metro will operate until 04:00 on April 12, and travel will be free from 23:00 on April 11 to 04:00 on April 12. The information is released by the Tbilisi City Hall.
Additionally, by the decision of the capital's City Hall, nine temporary bus routes were also established for April 12-13.
"Buses will transport passengers from 08:00 to 20:00 to the Mukhatgverdi, Vashlijvari, Kukia, New Kukia, Makhata, Saburtalo, Grmaghele, Veli, and Varketili cemeteries."

Buses will operate from the metro stations: "Marjanishvili," "Delisi," "Sarajishvili," and the area adjacent to "Varketili," as well as from the upper exit of "Didube," Station Square (opposite "Tbilisi Central"), Besarion Chichinadze Street (opposite Building N25), and Varketili III Micro-district – from the intersection of Shuamta and Abashvili streets.
"Citizens will use the buses on the mentioned routes free of charge for two days," – is stated in the information from Tbilisi City Hall.
